literal.prompt: Какой действующий вулкан расположен на острове Росса в Антарктиде?

finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The prompt asks for the active volcano on Ross Island, Antarctica. Retained GVP identifies Erebus as the southernmost active volcano and places it on Ross Island (Erebus L80,L116-L117); its Antarctic catalogue places Erebus among Ross Island volcanoes (L1050), also consistent with BAS L43@P1. The three distractors are genuine Antarctic volcanic features but in distinct settings: Deception Island (L224), Deacon Peak on Penguin Island in the South Shetlands (L223), and Toney Mountain in Marie Byrd Land (L216). Only Erebus matches Ross Island.
finalGroupBindings.locator: GVP Erebus L80,L116-L117; GVP Antarctica L216,L223-L224,L1050; BAS L43@P1

finalGroupBindings.literal: Это Эребус. В его кратере долго существует лавовое озеро.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: GVP states the Erebus summit crater contains an active lava lake, with continuous activity documented since 1972 (L116-L117,L667-L668).

finalGroupBindings.literal: Извержения у бухты Телефон на острове Десепшен происходили в 1967, 1969 и 1970 годах.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: GVP records eruptions at Telefon Bay on Deception Island in 1967 and 1970, plus a 1969 eruption that destroyed the Chilean base (L224-L225); this is a specific fact about the Deception volcanic island.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Эребус на острове Росса — самый южный действующий вулкан Земли.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The retained GVP description calls Erebus the world’s southernmost active volcano and locates it on Ross Island (L80,L116), an additional option-specific fact beyond prompt/key.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Пик Дикон на острове Пингвин — базальтовый шлаковый конус; рядом расположен кратер Петрен.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: GVP identifies Deacon Peak as a basaltic scoria cone on Penguin Island, off King George Island in the South Shetlands; it also describes the nearby Petrel Crater (L223).

finalGroupBindings.literal: Тони-Маунтин — вулканический массив в земле Мэри Бэрд с центральной кальдерой около 2,8 км в диаметре.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: GVP locates Toney Mountain in east-central Marie Byrd Land and describes its volcanic massif and central summit caldera, about 2.8 km across (L216).
